title: Vickers Wellington HE320
memorial_details: description: Royal Air Force / In Memory of / Sergeant VICTOR GEORGE BAILEY. / 1585910, Royal Air Force Volunteer Reserve. / Wireless Operator, aged 20 yrs. / of Rainham, Essex. / And / Sergeant LOUIS GROVER MARTIN. / R/182617 Royal Canadian Air Force. / Rear Gunner, aged 22 yrs. / of Big River, Saskatchewan,/ Canada. / Who died when their Wellington Bomber / Crashed in Ford / On 9th. January 1944.
